第一卷 第165章 遗境屠夫（第1页）
遗境屠夫（遗境屠夫（第22页）只有三块。吞噬完成后，他的仙骨，依旧是12块。三块仙骨中的其中一块，给他的感觉不是天生的。是利用换骨之法换上去的。他现在算是明白，为什么苍玄弟子，给他那种不舒服的感觉。他皱着眉头。“希望和我想的不一样，整个苍玄弟子，都修炼了换骨之法，他们进入，是为了祁山和黑梧弟子的仙骨，甚至是苍玄弟子的仙骨。”“若真是这样，长生宗，真的是烂到底了。”简单的摸尸后，没有什么好东西。想将坐忘石塞进裤裆里。但是坐忘石释放出了一丝拒绝的情绪。林罪微微一愣，笑道。“将你放在那里，是因为你重要。”忽然。他感应到了自己留下的符种能量。……褚河握着剑的手有些发抖。他的前面，是一只长达四五米的狼妖。没有毛发，遍布鳞片，长着好几个流脓的伤疤。是一阶妖兽。褚河的剑劈在它的身上，只能嵌进去几分，剑身还被诡异的触手缠住。狼妖一扫尾，若不是他及时拔出剑抵抗，身体差点断成两节。吼~狼妖发出一声怒吼。一个大跳，扑向褚河。褚河冷着脸，仙力涌动，在狼妖距离他只有四米时。。他斩出一剑，剑劲劈在狼妖的脑袋上。削掉它的半个脑袋。狼妖倒在地上，由于惯性往前冲了十几米才停下来。褚河松了一口气。但是下一刻，没了半个脑袋的狼妖跌跌撞撞的站起身。继续冲向他。褚河面色一惊，“该死，都是些什么怪物，这都不死。”他想跑，但是他的意识，莫名的呆滞了一瞬。就是这一瞬，狼妖已经来到他的面前，将他撞飞出去。大半个身子，被撞得稀巴烂。眼见狼妖越来越近，他的眼里满是绝望。突然，一道刀光闪过，将狼妖剩下的半个脑袋斩下。狼妖倒在地上后，再也没有爬起来。褚河扭头看向右边，林罪的身影出现在他的视线里。他的眼里涌现激动的神色。“林罪，救救我。”林罪走上前，居高临下看着褚河，平静的问道。“你是不是想杀了我？”褚河连连摇头，“林师兄，我怎么想杀你。”林罪蹲下身提起褚河，褚河以为自己得救了。他看到，林罪的右手抓住他的头盖骨。左手捏住他的脖颈。他心中有一种不好的预感。咔~一声皮肉筋膜骨头断裂的声音响起。林罪随手将褚河的身体扔在一旁，手里提着他的脑袋。摇了摇头，“求救，也不知道把眼里的杀意藏好点。”他将褚河的脑袋扔出，一脚踢出。砰~脑袋炸成漫天碎肉。……接下来的几日。林罪没有丝毫顾忌。凡是他遇到的妖兽，无论任何品阶，杀。遇到的黑梧，苍玄弟子，杀。遇到的祁山弟子，杀。只要是他遇到的活物，通通杀了。不为其他，就因为这些东西，都想杀了他。……

Volume 1 Chapter 165 The Butcher of the Relics (Page 1)
The Relic Butcher (Relic Butcher (page 22)) only has three pieces. After the devouring is completed, his immortal bones are still 12. One of the three immortal bones gives him the feeling that it is not natural. It was replaced by the method of bone replacement. He now understands why the Cangxuan disciples gave him that uncomfortable feeling. He frowned. "I hope it is different from what I thought. The entire Cangxuan disciples, After practicing the method of bone replacement, they entered for the immortal bones of Qi Shan and Hei Wu disciples, and even the immortal bones of Cang Xuan disciples. "If this is true, the Changsheng Sect is really rotten to the core." After simply touching the corpse, there was nothing good. He wanted to stuff the Zuo Wang Stone into his crotch. But the Zuo Wang Stone showed a hint of rejection. Lin Zui was stunned for a moment and said with a smile. "I put you there because you are heavy." "Suddenly. He felt the energy of the talisman he had left behind... Chu He's hand holding the sword was trembling. In front of him was a wolf demon that was four to five meters long. It had no hair, was covered with scales, and had several pus-filled scars. It was a first-order monster. Chu He's sword struck its body and could only be embedded a little, and the sword body was still entangled with weird tentacles. The wolf demon swept away, if he hadn't pulled out the sword in time.抵抗，身体差点断成两节。吼~狼妖发出一声怒吼。一个大跳，扑向褚河。褚河冷着脸，仙力涌动，在狼妖距离他只有四米时。。他斩出一剑，剑劲劈在狼妖的脑袋上。削掉它的半个脑袋。狼妖倒在地上，由于惯性往前冲了十几米才停下来。褚河松了一口气。但是下一刻，没了半个脑The wolf demon stumbled to his feet and continued to rush towards him. Chu He looked shocked, "Damn it, what kind of monsters are they? They are not dead." He wanted to run, but his consciousness was inexplicably stagnant for a moment. At that moment, the wolf demon had already come to him and knocked him away. Most of his body was smashed. Seeing the wolf demon getting closer, his eyes were filled with despair. The sword flashed and cut off the remaining half of the wolf demon's head. The wolf demon fell to the ground and never got up. Chu He turned to look to the right, and Lin Zui's figure appeared in his eyes. "Lin Zui, help me." Lin Zui stepped forward, looked down at Chu He, and asked calmly, "Are you trying to kill me?" Chu He shook his head repeatedly. I want to kill you." Lin Zui knelt down and lifted Chu He. Chu He thought he was saved. He saw Lin Zui's right hand grabbing his skull and his left hand pinching his neck. He had a bad feeling in his heart. There was a sound of breaking skin, muscle, fascia and bones. Lin Zui threw Chu He's body aside, holding his head in his hand. He shook his head, "Please help me, I don't know how to hide the murderous intention in my eyes. Better." He threw Chu He's head out and kicked it out. Bang~ The head exploded into pieces of meat... In the next few days, Lin Zui didn't have any scruples. He killed all the monsters he encountered, no matter what level. Hei Wu, a Cangxuan disciple, he met. He killed all Qishan disciples. As long as they were living creatures he met, he killed them all. For no other reason, just because of these things, they all wanted to kill him...
